summary: Phase 3 (Documents gate + PENDING_DOCUMENTS) fully verified. Authored /app/backend/tests/test_phase3_documents.py with 35 focused tests covering every acceptance item: 35/35 PASS after minor fixes. Also ran the full backend suite (149 passed / 4 failed) — the 4 failures are pre-existing flakes (2 x transient Cloudflare 502 during multipart PNG upload in _release_docs helper of test_issues_1_to_6.py, and 2 x accumulated-state math checks in test_receivable_math_known_project and test_monitor_project_wise_and_dashboard_match) and are NOT caused by Phase 3. Backend verified: (1) YES action creates exactly ONE ECP at current_stage=PENDING_DOCUMENTS, current_team=LEAD, documents_released=false; a 2nd YES on same lead -> 400. (2) Registration is fully blocked: PENDING_DOCUMENTS ECP is absent from GET /api/ecps for role REGISTRATION, GET /api/leads/{id}/documents returns 403 while pending, and NO REGISTRATION_1 tasks exist (0 tasks total) while pending. (3) All 8 doc types upload (PAN, AADHAAR, ELECTRICITY_BILL, BANK_PASSBOOK, BANK_STATEMENT, CANCELLED_CHEQUE, PROPERTY_PAPER, TAX_RECEIPT); every response returns documents_status + released flag. (4) Bank alternatives work — any one of Passbook/Statement/Cheque completes the bank requirement. (5) Finance=YES: PAN+AADHAAR+BILL+BANK alone leaves documents_status.complete=false and ecp stays PENDING_DOCUMENTS; adding either PROPERTY_PAPER or TAX_RECEIPT completes AND auto-releases to REGISTRATION_1 (current_team=REGISTRATION). (6) Finance=NO: PAN+AADHAAR+BILL+one-bank completes & auto-releases; new ECP has exactly 4 applicable REGISTRATION_1 tasks (CSPDCL Registration, PPA Preparation, Cover Letter, CVA) — the 3 loan tasks exist but applicable=false. (7) Financing=YES releases with 7 applicable REGISTRATION_1 tasks (base 4 + Loan Documentation, Loan Filing, Bank Submission). (8) POST /documents/release -> 400 'Required documents are incomplete' when missing. (9) Ownership RBAC: a second LEAD user who does not own the lead gets 403 on upload/list/release; after reassign, the previous owner loses access (403) and the new owner gets 200. (10) ACCOUNTS/DISPATCH/INSTALLATION -> 403 on list & upload. (11) Unsupported types (.txt text/plain, application/octet-stream .exe) -> 400 'Only JPG, PNG or PDF'; >10MB -> 400 'too large'. (12) Replace/re-upload preserves history: previous doc becomes status=REPLACED and is returned under 'history' with uploader metadata. (13) Financing NO->YES flip while PENDING blocks release even after base+bank; adding a finance doc then releases. Financing YES->NO removes the finance requirement so POST /release succeeds. (14) Download returns raw PNG bytes with content-type image/png. (15) Grandfathering: an already-released REGISTRATION_1 ECP appears in Registration's /api/ecps list and its documents are readable by REGISTRATION role (200). (16) Dashboard counters: registration.pending_documents (aka Awaiting Documents), lead.pending_documents (Awaiting Documents), owner.ecp.PENDING_DOCUMENTS all populated. FRONTEND UI verified live: Lead Dashboard shows 'AWAITING DOCUMENTS 119'; Registration Dashboard shows 'AWAITING DOCUMENTS 120'; Owner Dashboard ECP section shows 'PENDING DOCUMENTS 120'. On LeadDetail: DocumentsPanel [data-testid=documents-panel] renders per-type rows (doc-row-PAN/AADHAAR/ELECTRICITY_BILL/BANK_PASSBOOK/BANK_STATEMENT/CANCELLED_CHEQUE, + PROPERTY_PAPER/TAX_RECEIPT when financing) each with doc-upload-<TYPE> button + hidden doc-input-<TYPE> file input, plus documents-overall-status badge showing 'DOCUMENTS INCOMPLETE', and documents-missing banner with the exact missing-list text. On ECPDetail with PENDING_DOCUMENTS: [data-testid=ecp-pending-docs-notice] renders with text 'Pending Documents — Registration 1 cannot start until all required customer documents are uploaded by the Lead Team' and the DocumentsPanel is embedded. Stage badge shows 'Pending Documents', team = LEAD, financing = Required. Object storage (Emergent) init succeeds at startup and every upload PUT + download GET works end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: _current_docs and _documents_status are defined TWICE (lines 331/335 and 476/480 — identical bodies). Second definitions override the first; recommend removing duplicates to reduce confusion (already ~1867 lines).
server.py: split into routers (leads, ecps, documents, commercial, payments) — file continues to grow past 1800 lines.

workflow.documents_complete signature accepts (current_types, financing) but there is no unit test asserting the corner case where financing flips and stored documents_released stays true; behaviour is currently correct (grandfathered ECPs at REGISTRATION_1 don't get pushed back) but worth an explicit test if product wants a policy on re-blocking.
Duplicate _documents_status could be a maintainability trap — if a future change patches only one, the other silently overrides it.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 acceptance verified end-to-end. New pytest file: /app/backend/tests/test_phase3_documents.py (35 tests, uses pytest-xdist safely — class-scoped 'other_lead' fixture returns {id, username, token} so parallel workers cannot cross-contaminate the reassign test). The two pre-existing suite failures in test_issues_*.py are (a) transient upload 502s and (b) stateful money-math that accumulates across historical test runs — not Phase 3 regressions. Registration ECP filter (ALLOWED_STAGES) already excludes PENDING_DOCUMENTS so no code change needed there. Legacy _qualify() helpers in the older test files upload docs after YES to auto-release to REGISTRATION_1 (main-agent already fixed this in iteration prior).
